findings.current: Inside an old guest room, a short, squat old man stood quietly watching the young man lying on the bed.
findings.defect: The draft adds that the old man was standing and weakens the specified downward direction of his gaze.
findings.rationale: The source states only that he was looking down at the young man; it does not establish whether he was standing.
findings.replacement: Inside an old guest room, a short, squat old man quietly looked down at the young man lying on the bed.
findings.source: 낡은 객실 안, 작달막한 체구의 노인이 침상에 누워 있는 청년을 가만히 내려다보고 있었다.

findings.current: I had suffered a minor Internal Injury, but even that was more than enough to make me grateful.
findings.defect: The draft makes the injury itself sound like the reason for gratitude, whereas Taekyung is grateful that the damage is only this severe.
findings.rationale: 이 정도만 해도 감지덕지다 evaluates the limited extent of the injury as fortunate.
findings.replacement: I had suffered a minor Internal Injury, but I was grateful it was only this bad.
findings.source: 미약한 내상을 입긴 했지만 이 정도만 해도 감지덕지다.

findings.current: “You scared the shit out of me, you crazy bastard!”
findings.defect: The draft adds profanity to the first clause that is not present in the source, intensifying the line beyond the profanity already carried by 미친놈아.
findings.rationale: 깜짝 놀랐잖아 means that Hyuk Mujin startled him; the stronger vulgarity belongs only to the closing insult.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin limped toward me, then let out a gasp and dropped down onto the floor.
findings.defect: “Limped” introduces an injured gait absent from the source before the sudden cramp occurs.
findings.rationale: 어기적거리는 describes slow, awkward, shuffling steps rather than a limp.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin shuffled toward me, then let out a gasp and dropped down onto the floor.
findings.source: 어기적거리는 발걸음으로 다가오던 혁무진이 헉, 소리를 내며 주저앉았다.

findings.defect: The draft omits Hyuk Mujin’s pain-stricken stammer.
findings.rationale: The repeated 쥐 preserves his disrupted delivery immediately after collapsing.

findings.defect: “Old bastard” adds explicit profanity not present in the disparaging but non-profane 노인네.
findings.rationale: “Old geezer” preserves Taekyung’s disrespectful register without inventing a stronger curse.

findings.current: “He’s on the first floor. He’s eating and drinking with Young Hero Cheongpung.”
findings.defect: The draft adds eating and loses the sense that the two are boisterously drinking.
findings.rationale: 부어라 마셔라 is an idiom for drinking freely and heavily; it does not state that they are eating.
findings.replacement: “He’s on the first floor. He’s drinking it up with Young Hero Cheongpung.”
findings.source: “일 층에 있습니다. 청 소협과 부어라 마셔라 하는 중이에요.”

findings.defect: The established rendering of 조장 is not used.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary establishes “Captain” as Hyuk Mujin’s address for Taekyung.

findings.current: “I don’t know when that old bastard might lose his temper and burn me to death. If you were me, wouldn’t you want to run?”
findings.defect: “Old bastard” adds explicit profanity absent from 노인네.
findings.rationale: The source is contemptuous but does not use a curse in this reference to Jeok Cheongang.
findings.replacement: “I don’t know when that old geezer might lose his temper and burn me to death. If you were me, wouldn’t you want to run?”
findings.source: “저 노인네가 언제 수틀려서 날 태워 죽일지 모르는데, 너 같으면 안 튀고 싶겠냐?”

findings.defect: The draft turns the source’s minced, trailing profanity into a fully explicit curse.
findings.rationale: 시바 is a softened alteration of a stronger Korean curse, and the ellipsis sustains its hesitant, incomplete delivery.

findings.current: “You’re starting to get the feeling too, aren’t you? I’d stake my hand and my entire fortune that they’re master and disciple. What are you willing to bet?”
findings.defect: The pledged body part is changed from Taekyung’s wrist to his hand.
findings.rationale: 손모가지 specifically refers to the wrist, and the concrete body part is part of Taekyung’s exaggerated wager.
findings.replacement: “You’re starting to get the feeling too, aren’t you? I’d stake my wrist and my entire fortune that they’re master and disciple. What are you willing to bet?”
findings.source: “슬슬 너도 감이 오지? 사제지간이라는 것에 내 손모가지와 전 재산 다 건다. 넌 뭐 걸래?”

findings.current: “Do you think the Fire King is some old man from the neighborhood? Who would steal from that old bastard?”
findings.defect: The second sentence adds explicit profanity absent from 노인네.
findings.rationale: The source conveys derision through 노인네 but does not use a profane insult here.
findings.replacement: “Do you think the Fire King is some old man from the neighborhood? Who would steal from that old geezer?”
findings.source: “화왕이 동네 할아버지냐? 누가 저 노인네 물건을 훔쳐?”

findings.defect: The established rendering of 조장 is not used.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary establishes “Captain” as Hyuk Mujin’s address for Taekyung.

summary: One unsupported physical action and several localized fidelity, register, and terminology defects require correction.
